other_failure_modes.name: In-memory processing of massive dataset without chunking
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to load and process a massive dataset entirely in memory using pandas, which can lead to Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors or extreme swapping, causing execution timeouts.

summary: The agent implements a solid baseline for the NYC Taxi Fare prediction task, featuring robust data cleaning and excellent domain-specific feature engineering. However, it fails to account for the massive scale of the dataset by processing it entirely in memory, which caused a timeout. Additionally, the agent uses a random train/validation split rather than a time-based split, ignoring the temporal nature of the dataset.
